description: Why: a full-table scan of pinned_cids for every GC candidate batch degrades GC performance as the pin set grows. What: gc_candidates.rs builds a query SELECT ... FROM articles WHERE cid NOT IN (SELECT cid FROM pinned_cids ...). If pinned_cids.cid is not indexed, SQLite performs a full scan of pinned_cids for each row in articles. The migration that creates pinned_cids should add an explicit index on cid, or the NOT IN should be rewritten as a LEFT JOIN / IS NULL pattern which the query planner can optimize more reliably.
title: gc_candidates NOT IN subquery lacks explicit index on pinned_cids.cid
